behavior: A successful backup posts exactly one heartbeat and the monitor reads UP.
verification: make backup-pvc ENV=prod && toolkit monitoring status --monitor prod-backup-pvc-heartbeat --expect up

behavior: A backup that fails at any step posts no heartbeat.
The absence of heartbeats raises an alert that reaches the operator's real notification channel.
No step of the demonstration adds a field manager to the prod CronJob.
verification: kubectl get cronjob pvc-backup -n kubelab -o json --show-managed-fields | jq -e '[.metadata.managedFields[].manager] | sort == ["argocd-controller", "k3s", "kubelab-toolkit"]'

behavior: The push token is absent from every committed file and survives an export/apply round trip unchanged.
The heartbeat monitor is not silenced by muted_notification_tags, asserted against the live monitor.
A heartbeat that cannot be delivered leaves the backup's exit status unchanged.
The token is registered in SECRET_CATALOG and appears in the prod secrets audit.
